'''Shelton''' is a city in [[Fairfield County, Connecticut]], United States. The population was 40,869 at the [[2020 United States Census]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://data.census.gov/cedsci/profile?g=0600000US0900168170|title=Census - Geography Profile: Shelton town, Fairfield County, Connecticut|publisher=[[United States Census Bureau]]|access-date=December 21, 2021}}</ref> The city is part of the [[Naugatuck Valley Planning Region, Connecticut|Naugatuck Valley Planning Region]].
